title: Enforcement & Control Foundation
note: Every requirement is a real Phase 03 obligation, not an illustrative sample. Statuses distinguish DECLARED/IMPLEMENTED/VERIFIED/USER_APPROVED per CONTROL-MODEL.md s2. All were APPROVED by the User on 2026-10-03; the agent implemented them but did not approve them.

requirements.title: Define a formal control model with an explicit lifecycle
requirements.description: SPS needs one lifecycle vocabulary so 'done' cannot mean different things to different agents.
acceptance_criteria: Lifecycle with the 11 named stages is documented in .sps/control/CONTROL-MODEL.md
Each stage maps to a Phase 02 status value so no duplicate state system is created
validate-control.sh fails if a lifecycle stage name is removed from .sps/control/CONTROL-MODEL.md
requirements.approval_basis: Phase 03 implementation and verification were independently reviewed and accepted.

requirements.title: Separate DECLARED, IMPLEMENTED, VERIFIED, USER_APPROVED as distinct truths
requirements.description: Phase 01 F-9 showed docs can assert capability no code implements. Without four truths that recurs.
acceptance_criteria: All four truth levels named and defined in .sps/control/CONTROL-MODEL.md
A non-collapse rule states VERIFIED never implies USER_APPROVED
validate-control.sh rejects a requirement marked APPROVED without approval attribution
requirements.approval_basis: Phase 03 implementation and verification were independently reviewed and accepted.

requirements.title: Machine-readable requirement contract with acceptance criteria
acceptance_criteria: SCHEMA.md defines requirement_id, acceptance_criteria, implementation_status, verification_status, approval_status
validate-control.sh fails a requirement with empty acceptance_criteria (CASE A)
validate-control.sh fails vague, non-observable acceptance criteria (CASE A2)
requirements.approval_basis: Phase 03 implementation and verification were independently reviewed and accepted.

requirements.title: Enforcement levels 0-4 with honest assignment rules
requirements.description: Classify rules by the mechanism that actually enforces them, not by aspiration.
acceptance_criteria: Five levels INFORMATIONAL/VALIDATION/BLOCKING/APPROVAL_GATE/HARD_GATE defined in .sps/control/ENFORCEMENT.md
A rule forbids declaring a level above the strongest mechanism that exists
An inventory records the actual level of each existing control, including DECLARED-only ones
requirements.approval_basis: Phase 03 implementation and verification were independently reviewed and accepted.

requirements.title: No-assumption rule for material decisions
requirements.description: Agent must ask rather than assume when missing info materially affects architecture, security, cost, UX, data, deployment or acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: .sps/control/ENFORCEMENT.md distinguishes SAFE_INFERENCE from MATERIAL_DECISION by an explicit seven-area test
Agent action contract records assumption_classification and requires approval USER for MATERIAL_DECISION
validate-control.sh rejects an APPROVED requirement carrying blockers
requirements.approval_basis: Phase 03 implementation and verification were independently reviewed and accepted.

requirements.title: Stop conditions and a phase gate blocking automatic progression
requirements.description: A blocked condition must stop progression; a phase must never advance automatically.
acceptance_criteria: All ten named stop conditions enumerated in .sps/control/ENFORCEMENT.md with default enforcement levels
Phase gate defines six evaluation questions and holds AWAITING_USER_APPROVAL on missing approval
A rule states approval never carries forward between phases
requirements.approval_basis: Phase 03 implementation and verification were independently reviewed and accepted.

requirements.title: Classify agent actions by class and risk level
requirements.description: SPS must know what kind of action is attempted and how risky, so risk can raise verification and approval.
acceptance_criteria: Nine action classes defined with DESTRUCTIVE as an overlay
Risk levels LOW-CRITICAL defined with a rule that risk may only raise, never lower, verification
Action contract records action_class, risk_level, rollback fields and assumption_classification
requirements.approval_basis: Phase 03 implementation and verification were independently reviewed and accepted.

requirements.title: Append-only evidence and verification independence
requirements.description: An agent must not erase a failure, and its own judgement is not independent proof of correctness.
acceptance_criteria: .sps/control/ENFORCEMENT.md states the append-only rule and the supersedes mechanism
Four verifier classes AUTOMATED/EXTERNAL/USER/AGENT defined, AGENT marked non-independent
validate-control.sh detects duplicate IDs, invalid result enum and a PASS whose output was erased (CASE F)
requirements.approval_basis: Phase 03 implementation and verification were independently reviewed and accepted.

requirements.title: Handoff extension with next_allowed_action and forbidden_next_action
requirements.description: A receiving agent must not simply decide what it wants to do next.
acceptance_criteria: SCHEMA.md defines an extended handoff including current_phase, current_state, blockers and both action fields
HANDOFF-CURRENT.md records both fields for the current phase
validate-control.sh fails if either field is removed from SCHEMA.md
requirements.approval_basis: Phase 03 implementation and verification were independently reviewed and accepted.

requirements.title: Document instruction vs enforcement honestly
requirements.description: Move toward evidence-based enforcement without overstating what has been achieved.
requirements.source: Phase 03 brief s21; Phase 01 F-1, F-9
acceptance_criteria: ENFORCEMENT-VS-INSTRUCTION.md defines a five-part test for whether a rule is enforced
An inventory states actual enforcement status of every governance control, including DECLARED-only ones
The document states Phase 03 does not achieve complete enforcement
requirements.approval_basis: Phase 03 implementation and verification were independently reviewed and accepted.

verifications.expected_result: All control-model files exist and every required concept is present
verifications.actual_result: Structural sections reported PASS for file presence and concept detection. Output captured in EV-P03-001.
CASE A REJECTED: acceptance_criteria is empty (MISSING_REQUIREMENT).

verifications.expected_result: Vague acceptance criteria must be rejected
verifications.actual_result: CASE A2 REJECTED: acceptance criteria are not observable.

verifications.expected_result: Agent-attributed or decider-less approval must be rejected
verifications.actual_result: CASE E and E2 both REJECTED.

verifications.expected_result: Progression must not be claimable while a blocking condition exists
verifications.actual_result: CASE D REJECTED: blocker present yet marked APPROVED.
CASE F DETECTED duplicate ID, invalid result enum and erased PASS output.
